x-contract-notes: Inputs allow missing top-level fields for semantic preflight. Nested fields are closed. Required-for-primary expressions are service gates, not JSON presence. Unknown fields and invalid types rejected.

Explicitly choose method ID and version. Specialized artifact/dataset refs are authorized immutable typed data; their row shapes and full artifact contracts remain in the named owner documents and must be materialized before the particular method is implemented.
All methods are planned. RunResult state/evidence/permission/currency/cohort checks are semantic. No observed claim without authorized evidence. Scratch has no workspace/ref/persistence.

DatasetPayload selects an explicit closed row schema, version and workspace. Data bindings are additional semantic gates; dataset/ArtifactEnvelope refs are validated by role, scope, kind and version before execution. Extra field values in feature/dimension/parameter mappings must use the versioned catalog, not arbitrary execution code.

Connection and SyncRun schemas are internal only; credential_ref and cursor never returned by public DTO. WorkbenchPreferences are user scoped, settings allowlist and no company refs enforced by service. Specialized artifact schemas supplement method outputs and existing owner contracts.
